products.title: Basil, Lemon and Cinnamon Bouquet Mix
products.body_html:
Basil, Lemon and Cinnamon Mix, Ocimum basilicum - 50 or 200 seeds avg

Basil holds up as a cut flower filler and adds the perfect touch to late summer and fall bouquets. A striking touch in landscapes, kitchen gardens, cutting gardens and containers that will produce all season when harvested weekly.

Planting Tips:
  • Sun to part sun.
  • 24"H.
  • Summer annual.
  • Plant seeds directly in the garden or start indoors for an earlier start.
  • Plant after last danger of frost has past and the soil has begun to warm, typically a couple weeks past last frost date.
  • Cover seed lightly.
  • 5-10 days to germinate.
  • 85-100 days to bloom.
Keep the Blooms Coming:
  • Harvest for bouquets as the flower heads begin to develop.
  • Harvest stems at the base of the stem for a whole season of re-growth.
  • This will produce multiple new sprouts from the base of the plant that will produce more strong stems for fresh weekly harvests.
  • Remember that herbs need to be harvested on a regular basis to keep the plant fresh and growing.
  • Treat basil stems harvested for bouquets as cut flowers and plunge into clean water with flower food added for maximum vase life.
  • Basil stems do not like refrigeration.

Planting Tips:

  • A warm-season tender annual vine that prefers full sun.
  • Start seeds indoors 4-6 weeks before planting date or cast seeds directly in the garden.

  • Allow 7-10 days to germinate.

To Cure:

  • Leave on vine until dry, remove before frost.
  • Place gourds in a warm, dry, well-ventilated location in a single layer on clean newspaper not touching one another.
  • Turn the gourds frequently and promptly remove any showing signs of decay.

Tunnel Supplies (see video above):

  • Livestock or cattle panels, ours are 4’ W x 16’ L.
  • Strong stakes 4’ or so long, 2-3 stakes per side of panel.
  • Heavy-duty cable ties to secure panels to stakes.
  • Sledge hammer.

Drive 2-3 stakes into the ground on each side of the proposed tunnel. Bend the flexible panel and place it in between the stakes. Cable tie the panel to the stakes. If building a multi-panel tunnel, cable tie the panels together as well.


We made raised beds that run along the outside edge of both sides of the tunnel. Mulch the inside of the tunnel deeply and plant on the outside edge.

We’ve grown gourds, cucumbers, squash, and small size cantaloupes with great success. Enjoy!

products.body_html:
Fill your summer garden with color and welcome butterflies at the same time! The Butterfly Garden Seed Set combines five easy-to-grow favorites with a variety of flower shapes, heights, and bright colors that create an inviting garden for visiting butterflies.

Cosmos ‘Sensation Mix’ brings open blooms in shades of pink, rose, and white. Sunflower ‘Just Crazy’ adds height and striking golden-orange flowers with an unusual, playful form. Zinnia ‘Benary’s Giant Mix’ provides large, vibrant blooms in a rainbow of colors, while Gomphrena ‘QIS™ Mix’ adds globe-shaped flowers in rich jewel tones. Basil ‘Mrs. Burns’ Lemon’ completes the garden with fragrant foliage and delicate flower spikes.

Plant them together for a lively summer display, providing plenty of color for you to enjoy and flowers for butterflies to visit throughout the season.

Seed Set Includes:

  • Cosmos, Sensation Mix, 50 seeds avg
    Graceful plants with open-faced flowers in shades of pink, rose, and white.
  • Sunflower, Just Crazy, 50 seeds avg
    Golden-orange sunflowers with an unusual petal form and large green-gold centers that bring height and personality to the garden.
  • Zinnia, Benary’s Giant Mix, 50 seeds avg
    Large, colorful blooms in a wide range of shades that create a bold summer display.
  • Gomphrena, QIS™ Mix, 50 seeds avg
    Colorful globe-shaped blooms in pink, red, orange, and purple that add long-lasting color and texture.
  • Basil, Mrs. Burns’ Lemon, 50 seeds avg
    Fragrant lemon-scented foliage and flower spikes that add greenery, scent, and another layer of garden interest.

Each variety is packaged separately and includes our expert growing instructions!

Perfect for:
Colorful summer beds, beginner-friendly flower gardens, and gardeners who want to enjoy flowers and butterflies together.

products.title: Seed Set, Birdwatcher
products.body_html:
Create a garden that gives you more reasons to stop, look, and listen. The Birdwatcher Garden Seed Set brings together colorful flowers, seed-filled stems, and varied plant heights to create an inviting garden space for visiting songbirds.

Zinnia ‘Benary’s Giant Mix’ and Zinnia ‘Giant Cactus Mix’ fill the planting with bright summer color and develop seed heads birds can investigate later in the season. Millet ‘Lime Light’ adds graceful green plumes and an abundance of seed, while Sunflower ‘Rouge Royale’ provides bold, dark-red blooms followed by sunflower seeds that are especially appealing to seed-eating birds. Basil ‘Mrs. Burns’ Lemon’ adds fragrant foliage, branching structure, and another layer of texture throughout the planting.

Left standing as the flowers mature, this mix creates a lively garden filled with changing color, seed heads, and natural places for birds to perch and forage. It’s designed to be enjoyed right where it grows — by you and by the feathered visitors that stop by.

Seed Set Includes:

  • Zinnia, Benary’s Giant Mix, 50 Seeds avg.
    Large, colorful blooms that brighten the garden and produce seed heads as the flowers mature.
  • Zinnia, Giant Cactus Mix, 50 Seeds avg.
    Distinctive zinnias with long, narrow petals that add texture, movement, and additional seed-bearing flowers.
  • Millet, Lime Light, 50 Seeds avg.
    Soft chartreuse plumes that add height and structure while producing seed that makes the garden more inviting to birds.
  • Sunflower, Rouge Royale,  50 Seeds avg.
    Rich, warm-toned branching sunflowers that develop seed-filled centers for visiting songbirds to explore.
  • Basil, Mrs. Burns’ Lemon, 50 Seeds avg.
    Fragrant, branching plants that add greenery, texture, and places for small birds to move through the garden.

Perfect for:

Backyard bird gardens, wildlife-friendly flower beds, gardeners who enjoy birdwatching, colorful summer plantings, and anyone who wants to leave flowers standing for birds to enjoy as the season progresses.
